## Publication checklist

- [ ] I have the right to submit every included file.
- [ ] Copied, generated, derived, and third-party material is identified.
- [ ] License and attribution evidence is included.
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed.
- [ ] The contribution contains no credentials, private prompts, transcripts, researcher
      data, or unapproved personal information.
- [ ] Published package bytes are unchanged, or the package version is bumped.
- [ ] Relevant validation and tests pass.
